method.pairReports: Match artifact name, artifact-relative JSON path and RFC 6901 JSON pointer. Read dict/list values recursively; stop at full assessment results (setups, jobsAttempted, phaseTimings) or phase objects with outcomes.
method.deduplicate: When a row contains result and report.result, require exact deep equality, retain report.result once. Require summary.publicExamples to equal the corresponding fields of public-consumer-examples.json, omit that duplicate file. Keep separately executed scenarios, repeated runs and other hosts.
method.outcomeChecks: Require unique identities per phase/report; compare every retained outcome field except setups, evidence and executionMs. This includes IDs, local IDs, verdicts, countedAsKilled and pseudoTested where present. The ID-only Node load rows cannot prove source-edit identity.
method.snapshots: Baseline and candidate retain scalar phase counters and timings, enabled operators, full perOperator rows and any phaseTimings, plus full report completeness, quality when present, setup job states/counts/time limits/timings. Shared outcome lists are interned under outcomeSets; sharedOutcomesRef applies unchanged to both builds. addedOutcomesRef applies only to candidate; removedOutcomesRef only to baseline.
method.sourceChecks: Compare complete source results after removing only zero-valued coverageSuppressions fields (0 on functions; {count:0,hints:[]} on sources). Retain SHA-256 of the unmodified source arrays encoded as UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators and literal Unicode, and retain every remaining difference.
method.assessmentChanges: Compare retained snapshots excluding keys ending Ms, timings, phaseTimings and diagnostics. Record all differences except newly added eligibleSites/excludedSites fields, whose exact values remain in candidate.perOperator. No other metric is normalised.
method.fullReportJobArithmetic: Sum setup baseline, coverage and direct typecheck jobs (one when their job object has ms), plus each compilerStrictness.job (one), phase jobsAttempted, workerBaselineJobs and preparedBaselineJobs. setup attemptedJobs fields retain this derivation. Assert sum equals report jobsAttempted.
method.hashes: Artifact digest is GitHub metadata; newly downloaded ZIPs were checked against it. Every compared source JSON file has SHA-256 of its raw bytes. Existing extracted package/runtime artifacts use the supplied audit coordinates and matching GitHub metadata; their ZIPs were not downloaded again.
method.timings: Retain original floating-point milliseconds, including nulls and partial-report availability. Timings are single shared-runner samples; no performance claim.
method.reproduce: For each artifacts.files entry, verify raw JSON SHA-256, follow pointers, apply the deduplication and identity rules, then reconstruct baseline outcomes from shared+removed and candidate outcomes from shared+added references. Compare the two stored snapshots using the rules above.

normalisations.sourceCoverageSuppressions: 724 added fields, all zero; no source or function assessment changed
normalisations.perOperatorSiteCounts: eligibleSites and excludedSites are new in 0.12.0 and are retained without treating their absence in 0.11.0 as zero

equivalentMutants.basis: Discarding the numeric literal has no effect in equivalent(); dropping terminal bare return has no effect in terminal(). Neither function reflects on source. These closed examples do not estimate equivalence elsewhere.

Discarding the numeric literal in equivalent() and dropping terminal bare returns in terminal() and values() do not change this fixture. The functions do not reflect on source. These closed examples do not estimate equivalence elsewhere.

limits: No builds, dependency installation or new assessments were run. This compares the supplied CI artifacts at the exact heads, rather than rerunning fixtures locally.

No retained full source assessment contains a coverage hint. The 724 zero-valued suppression fields prove format additions on these fixtures, not the new suppressed-status behavior. Partial suppression support remains outside this release.

Statement operator proof rows retain only the operator phase and totalJobsAttempted. The extra extreme job is inferred from totals and the exact proof source assertion changing pseudoTesting.planned from 5 to 6; its identity/verdict is not retained in those rows.
130 Node load-failure rows retain outcome ID and verdict but no source edit identity. There are 210 outcomes in those rows; identity claims for them are limited to IDs and scenario positions.

Runner diagnostics, individual setup execution receipts, execution IDs and temporary filesystem paths are excluded from outcome comparison. Source arrays are compared in full apart from documented zero suppression fields.
Reports without an outer CLI envelope have no retained quality state. Missing partial-report metrics and baseline phaseTimings remain missing, not zero.

Artifact ZIP digest verification was performed for the 11 small downloads in this slice. Already supplied extracted package/runtime evidence was checked against audit coordinates and hashed per source JSON; ZIPs were not downloaded again.
Timings are one sample per scenario on shared hosts. No speedup, rare-failure fix, notice audit, stage validation or publication approval is inferred.
